mentions.heading: Third-party intellectual property infringement claims
mentions.detail: May need licenses, pay damages/royalties, cease selling components, redesign products or rebrand
mentions.quote: Further, if we are determined to have or believe there is a high likelihood that we have infringed upon a third party’s intellectual property rights, we may be required to cease making, selling or incorporating certain components or intellectual property into the goods and services we offer, to pay substantial damages and/or license royalties, to redesign our products and services and/or to establish and maintain alternative branding for our products and services.

mentions.heading: Our operations could be adversely affected by events outside of our control, such as natural disasters, wars or health epidemics.
mentions.detail: Fremont and Nevada factories in seismic regions; Shanghai in flood-prone area; Texas hit by 2021 winter storms
mentions.quote: For example, our Fremont Factory and Gigafactory Nevada are located in seismically active regions in Northern California and Nevada, and our Gigafactory Shanghai is located in a flood-prone area.
